SELECT DISTINCT p."ID", p."Birthday", p."Diagnosis"
FROM main."Laboratory" l
JOIN main."Patient" p ON l."ID" = p."ID"
WHERE l."GOT" >= 60 AND l."Date" >= '1997-01-01' AND l."Date" <= '1997-12-31';
